thread:
elena: quick sync — we need one consolidated GA acceptance checklist that we can hand to legal/finance/oncall tomorrow. focus: SLA numbers, docs coverage, support runbooks, monitoring alerts, and pricing tiers. short bullets pls.
jack: +1. we still need the final latency p95 target for hosted vs dedicated. proposed: hosted p95 < 250ms for short requests, dedicated p95 < 120ms for reserved engines. anyone object?
priya: hosted 250ms sounds tight for 99th perciles with cold starts. can we split: warm p95 and cold p95? also need clear error budget for retries/fallbacks.
elena: good point. propose: hosted warm p95 < 200ms, hosted cold p95 < 1s (with cold-start budget), dedicated p95 < 120ms. error budget wording: 99.9% availability per month for hosted API, with a separate degraded-tier SLA when model fallbacks are used.
jack: noted. engineering can instrument warm vs cold in the telemetry. will add a tag `latency.cold=true` in traces.
noah: docs: I'll own the customer-facing SLA page + migration guide. checklist for docs: quickstart examples for hosted/dedicated/private, explicit behavior for model fallbacks, rate-limit semantics, and a FAQs section for billing edge cases. ETA: draft by Fri EOD.
tina: support readiness: need two things — an internal triage runbook and a customer-facing support matrix. internal runbook should include: steps to verify model variant/fallback, how to escalate to infra oncall, and billing/contact flow for quota disputes. I can pair with jack to write the triage playbook.
priya: monitoring: dashboards we need now — per-route latency histograms, token-per-request cost, error-rate by cause (model error, infra error, rate-limit). Alerting: page on sustained error rate >1% for 5m, token-cost spike >50% vs baseline for 10m, and regional capacity drop triggers fallback. Also need an automated alert that creates a shared incident channel with owners prepopulated.
ops-bot: ACTIONS created: ga-checklist/owner-elena/due-2026-03-27, docs-draft/noah/due-2026-03-26, triage-playbook/tina+jack/due-2026-03-25, monitoring-dashboard/priya/due-2026-03-24.
elena: pricing readiness: we need final pricing table + examples showing cost per 1k tokens under typical batching. finance asked for cost-sensitivity scenarios (low, medium, high throughput) with unit economics. who can own?
jack: eng can supply perf curves and cost-per-token with current quantization profiles. i'll produce a CSV with throughput vs unit cost for three model classes by Tue.
tina: support staffing: recommend 24/7 triage for first 30 days post-GA, then move to tiered coverage. also need a training doc and a short internal runbook video.
noah: docs question — do we publish the full SLA formula (how availability is computed) or a simplified summary? legal prefers formula to be explicit.
elena: legal wants formula in the contract appendix, but customer page should have a simplified summary + link to appendix. put both in docs checklist.
priya: one more risk: autoscale cold-starts leading to bursts of latency. mitigation: warm pool for top 20% of routes and progressive ramping. need an ops config flag. jack — can you add warm-pool param to autoscaler?
jack: yes — adding `min_warm_workers` and route affinity rule. will land a PR and a short config doc.
elena: summary of decisions so far: hosted warm/cold SLA split, dedicated tighter p95, 99.9% availability target, fallback SLA note, monitoring + alerts list, docs owner(noah), support owner(tina), engineering owner(jack), SRE owner(priya).
noah: acked. i'll structure the docs page like: TL;DR SLA box, What this means for customers, Failure modes + fallbacks, Pricing examples, Migration notes, Contact & escalation.
tina: i'll create the internal triage playbook skeleton and drop into #support-runbooks. ping me if you want a dry-run session.
priya: will stand up the dashboards and share links when ready. plan to stub alerts in staging tomorrow so we can iterate on thresholds.
jack: PRs for instrumentation and autoscaler flags will reference the checklist ticket.
elena: action items — owners confirm: noah (customer docs) due 2026-03-26, tina+jack (triage & runbook) due 2026-03-25, priya (monitoring + alerts) due 2026-03-24, jack (perf curves) due Tue, elena will consolidate final checklist and send to legal/finance 2026-03-27. if anyone cannot meet, flag now.
jack: on it.
noah: on it.
tina: can do.
priya: will meet deadlines.
elena: great — will run a 15m alignment tomorrow 9:30am PT to confirm artifacts before handoff. thanks everyone :rocket:
